en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Ibrahim Bin Muhammad Al Madainy, form the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘He<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the singing (music), and I was present, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not enter the house which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Turned away (Blessings) from its inhabitants’.
en.sarwar: 18. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Madiniy from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Once abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
was asked about music (and singing) when I was present. He (the Imam) said, ‘Do not enter the houses whose inhabitants Allah disregards.’”
